#### ACRA — Corporate filing and governance

**Status:** Verified evidence; case application unresolved

**ACRA annual return filing deadline** (party in scope: Company)
- **ACRA rule explanation:** A live Singapore company must file an annual return each year, including if inactive or dormant or granted an IRAS tax waiver. The general deadline is five months after FYE for listed companies and seven months for non-listed companies. A company with share capital that keeps a branch register outside Singapore generally has an additional month. The filing deadline is separate from AGM compliance and tax filing. Determine whether the company remains live, its listing status, FYE, share capital and any overseas branch register. The filing date is calculated from the applicable period after FYE. Inactivity and an IRAS tax-filing waiver do not remove the ACRA annual-return duty while the company is live. This rule does not determine whether financial statements are exempt from filing. A case-specific conclusion requires: Entity live status and type. FYE and filing period. Listed status, share capital and branch register maintained outside Singapore. The general deadlines here describe current guidance; a past filing year requires evidence for that year. Check ACRA for a company-specific deadline and any approved extension.  For the stated FYE and company type, the general annual-return date is 31/07/2026. If the company has share capital and maintains an overseas branch register, one additional month applies, making the date 31/08/2026. [Deadline & requirements for annual returns | Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority](https://www.acra.gov.sg/manage/companies/legal-requirements-common-offences/filing-annual-returns-companies/deadline-requirements/)
- **Application unresolved:** Company facts required to calculate the annual return deadline: overseas branch register status. No due date has been calculated.

**Source:** Deadline & requirements for annual returns | Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (live external)
- **Verified official source excerpt** (supports ACRA annual return filing deadline): All companies in Singapore must file annual returns with ACRA on time to avoid penalties of up to $600. Deadlines depend on company type and financial year end (FYE).
- **Verified official source excerpt** (supports ACRA annual return filing deadline): Company type | Filing deadline
Listed companies | Within five months after FYE
Listed companies with: A share capital; An overseas branch register; | Within six months after FYE
Non-listed companies | Within seven months after FYE
Non-listed companies with: A share capital; An overseas branch register; | Within eight months after FYE

- **Verified official source excerpt** (supports ACRA annual return filing deadline): • Inactive or dormant
- **Verified official source excerpt** (supports ACRA annual return filing deadline): • Granted a tax waiver by the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (IRAS)

**ACRA annual return filing deadline** (party in scope: Company)
- **ACRA rule explanation:** A live Singapore company must file an annual return each year, including if inactive or dormant or granted an IRAS tax waiver. The general deadline is five months after FYE for listed companies and seven months for non-listed companies. A company with share capital that keeps a branch register outside Singapore generally has an additional month. The filing deadline is separate from AGM compliance and tax filing. Determine whether the company remains live, its listing status, FYE, share capital and any overseas branch register. The filing date is calculated from the applicable period after FYE. Inactivity and an IRAS tax-filing waiver do not remove the ACRA annual-return duty while the company is live. This rule does not determine whether financial statements are exempt from filing. A case-specific conclusion requires: Entity live status and type. FYE and filing period. Listed status, share capital and branch register maintained outside Singapore. The general deadlines here describe current guidance; a past filing year requires evidence for that year. Check ACRA for a company-specific deadline and any approved extension.
